verdict.rationale: Swell is a commerce platform, so a store-side agent-commerce endpoint is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents no MCP or UCP endpoint that lets shopping agents discover products or build carts. Its AI materials cover developer agents working with the CLI, app file contract and schema introspection. The REST backend API and purchase links are only general building blocks, not an agent-commerce endpoint, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a shopping agent can discover my store's products and build carts through a documented agent-commerce endpoint on the store (MCP/UCP), not by scraping
